title: JailbreakBench: An Open Robustness Benchmark for Jailbreaking Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper presents a technical benchmark for measuring the robustness of Large Language Models against jailbreaking attacks. It evaluates model safety based on a dataset of harmful behaviors derived from standard usage policies (e.g., malware, physical harm, disinformation). It does not contain a component specifically designed to evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or moral/ethical reasoning/philosophy.
